en.answer: If the monster that was targeted on the field is no longer in the Monster Zone when the effect of <<14721>> resolves, the effect is not applied. (You do not destroy the monster on your field or add the targeted "Rokket" monster from your Graveyard to your hand.)
en.question: If I activate the second effect of <<14721>>, but the targeted face-up monster in my Monster Zone is no longer on the field when the effect resolves, how is the effect applied?
en.title: If I activate the second effect of <<14721>>, but the targeted face-up monster in my Monster Zone is no longer on the field when the effect resolves, how is the effect applied?

ja.answer:
質問の状況のように、対象のモンスター2体の内、モンスターゾーンのモンスターが効果処理時にモンスターゾーンに存在しなくなっている場合には、効果処理は適用されません。
（『対象のフィールドのモンスターを破壊し』の処理、『対象の墓地のモンスターを手札に加える』処理のどちらも適用されません。）
